from scipy import signal
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import sys
import math

#计算需要绘图的行和列
def getRowAndCol(data):
    cnum= set()
    for param in data:
        cnum.add(param['drawingNo'])
    row=1
    col=1
    if len(cnum)>1:
      col=2
      row= math.ceil(len(cnum)/col)
    return row,col

#读取文件
def getFileData(filePath):
    try:
        value = pd.read_table(filePath, header=None).values
        if isinstance(value[0][0],str) and "," in value[0][0]:
            valuelist=[int(j)for i in value for j in str(i[0]).strip(",").split(",")]
            value =np.array(valuelist)
        return value.reshape(-1,)
    except:
        raise Exception("{} not find".format(filePath))

def pwelch(x,n=1024,fs=491520000):
    window =signal.get_window('hanning',n + 1)[1:]
    print("111111", len(window))
    f, s= signal.welch(x, fs=fs, window=window, nperseg=n, noverlap=None, nfft=n, detrend=False, return_onesided=False,
                        scaling='density',axis=-1)
    return f,s

#通过文件列表,计算矩阵值
def getMatrixValue(fileList):
    realNumber =getFileData(fileList[0])
    if len(fileList)== 1:
        return realNumber
    imaginary= getFileData(fileList[1])
    return realNumber+imaginary* 1j

#psd算法绘图
def psdDrawing(p,n,fs, row, col):
    color =p['color']
    drawingNo=p['drawingNo']
    legendId =p['legendId']
    x=getMatrixValue(p['fileList'])
    x=x.flatten()
    f,s=pwelch(x,n,fs)
    sp=f.shape[0]
    plt.subplot(row, col,(drawingNo +1))
    plt.plot(f[:sp],10*np.log10(s[:sp]),c=color, label=str(legendId))
    plt.title('fig'+str(drawingNo))
    ax= plt.gca()
    ylabel= ax.yaxis.get_label().get_text()
    if ylabel !='' and ylabel != 'PSD':
        plt.ylabel('')
        plt.xlabel('')
    else:
        plt.ylabel('PSD')
        plt.xlabel('Frequency(MHz)')
    plt.legend()

#·abs算法绘图
def absDrawing(p,row, col):
    color =p['color']
    drawingNo=p['drawingNo']
    legendId =p['legendId']
    x=getMatrixValue(p['fileList'])
    x=x.flatten()
    y=np.abs(x)
    plt.subplot(row,col,(drawingNo +1))
    plt.plot(y,c=color,label=str(legendId))
    plt.title('fig'+ str(drawingNo))
    ax=plt.gca()
    ylabel=ax.yaxis.get_label().get_text()
    if ylabel !='' and ylabel != 'ABS':
        plt.ylabel('')
        plt.xlabel('')
    else:
        plt.ylabel('ABS')
    plt.legend()

#属性名同步映射
def transform_structure(data):
    transformed = []
    for i, item in enumerate(data):
        new_item = {
            "drawingNo": i,
            "color": item["figureColor"],
            "legendId": item["legend"],
            "algorithms": item["algorithm"],
            "fileList": item["filePath"]
        }
        transformed.append(new_item)

    return transformed
    

#绘制频谱分析图
def analysisPlot(data, n, fs, label=None, color=None, title=None, fig_num=1, block=False):
    print("看看数据情况", data ,n ,fs)
    row,col = getRowAndCol(data)
    for i, p in enumerate(data):
        if p['algorithms'] =='PSD':
            psdDrawing(p,n,fs,row,col)
        elif p['algorithms'] == 'ABS':
            absDrawing(p,row,col)
    plt.show()
    


if __name__ == "__main__":
   dataArray= VTableTemp["value"]
   dataArray= transform_structure(dataArray)
   analysisPlot(dataArray, VInputNumber4["value"], VInputNumber3["value"])
